turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
Out of time. It's 4:15, Hale, and I'm not leaving until you answer my question: who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved while that zero is sitting in the gradebook, and I'm writing down that you wanted this marked resolved before you'd answered a single question. Who decided, Hale?
I've answered that. Either you tell me what you have against Owen's essay, or I'm walking down to the principal's office the moment I leave this room.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
No. Repeating it doesn't make it evidence, Hale. Put something in front of me, or I'm going upstairs.
